fair_value_reason: This is the mean of the five round-2 fair values ($100, $96, $94, $94, $96). All of them now use the corrected inputs: about 5.40-5.54B shares including the full greenshoe and some or all of the escrow shares, the $15.6B NCI deducted, and no phantom follow-on. The remaining spread comes from the foundry option ($75-140B), where the checked evidence supports about $110-120B. Taking that centre in agents 1 and 2 moves their values by about +$3 and -$2, which leaves about $96, 20% below spot.
supervisor_summary: In round 2 the five forecasters converged further: all now use the corrected share count, the $23B raise and the NCI, with fair values of $94-100 (mean $96) against a $120 price and P(>=120 in a year) of 0.44-0.46. My checks found that no 14A customer is named yet: Tesla's Terafab is a collaboration with no disclosed revenue, Maia 2 and Apple are reports, and a reported Fitch upgrade is unverified. Micron's blowout quarter is confirmed, but it cuts both ways for Intel. None of this justifies moving off the forecasters' mean, which I keep with low confidence: median about $111 in a year and about $119 at end-October. The swing factors are a named 14A anchor (upside) and the Q3 print plus the lock-up ending in late October (two-way event risk).
key_drivers: Server-CPU shortage and pricing (DCAI +59% y/y in Q2; channel prices up 10-20%), and whether it lasts into 2027 as AMD and Arm capacity arrives. Micron's $54.2B quarter confirms AI-server demand, but memory costs hit PC units

A named, binding 14A anchor customer. Today the evidence is the CFO's 'conviction' (Sept 2), a Tesla Terafab collaboration with no disclosed revenue, report-only Apple 18A-P and Maia 2 deals, and $293M a quarter of external foundry revenue. 14A risk production is set for H2 2027, with HVM in 2028
Valuation: about 58x FY27 consensus EPS of $2.06. The agents' revised fair values cluster at $94-100 (mean $96), so the multiple must compress as EPS grows

Dilution and balance sheet: 5.40-5.54B shares after the $23B raise, the company lock-up ending at the Q3 print with the S-3ASR shelf open, 2027 capex 'significantly above' 2026, and $50.5B of debt plus $15.6B of NCI
Event risk: the Q3 print (date unconfirmed, about Oct 22), 72-76% realized vol and a 2.9 beta to SPY
